title: Merge Two Store Drops
description: East and West each drop a night sales file. Merge them with unionByName into one Parquet dataset. Read INPUT_A_PATH and INPUT_B_PATH. Output columns: txn_id, store_id, product_id, quantity. Prefer unionByName over positional union. Write with overwrite. Run smoke / Submit full testcases.

problemStatement.overview: unionByName East + West sales drops; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: Two store drops must become one overnight fact table.
Positional union breaks if column order drifts.
yourTaskSteps: Write txn_id, store_id, product_id, quantity to OUTPUT_PATH.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that merges two store drops with unionByName.
hints: Do not use positional union alone.
txn_ids are unique across both sides within a testcase.

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
OUTPUT_PATH contains the union of INPUT_A and INPUT_B rows
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows
